# ActiveCA: Time use data from the general social survey of Canada to study active travel

- Bruno Santos, School of Earth, Environment and Society, McMaster
  University
- Mahdis Mogadhasi, School of Earth, Environment and Society, McMaster
  University
- Antonio Paez, School of Earth, Environment and Society, McMaster
  University

This paper describes {ActiveCA}, an open data product with Canadian time
use data. {ActiveCA} is an R data package that contains analysis-ready
data related to active travel spanning almost 40 years, extracted from
Cycles 2 (1986), 7 (1992), 12 (1998), 19 (2005), 24 (2010), 29 (2015),
and 34 (2022) of the Time Use Survey (TUS) from the General Social
Survey (GSS). Active travel episodes are characterized by mode, with
walking being part of every cycle and bicycling starting in 1992. The
attributes of active trips are the types of locations of origins and
destinations, the duration of trips, and episode weights for expanding
the trips to population-wide estimates. Based on the year of the survey,
a variety of locations are coded. In earlier cycles, these include home,
work or school, and other’s home, whereas in later cycles these are
augmented with locations such as grocery stores, restaurants, outdoor
destinations, and others. The geographical resolution includes the
province and whether the episode was in an urban or rural setting.

<https://doi-org.libaccess.lib.mcmaster.ca/10.1177/23998083251374724>

## Installation

You can install the development version of ActiveCA from
[GitHub](https://github.com/dias-bruno/ActiveCA) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("dias-bruno/ActiveCA")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cycling_1992`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/cycling_1992.md)
  : Preprocessed cycling episodes (1992).
- [`cycling_1998`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/cycling_1998.md)
  : Preprocessed cycling episodes (1998).
- [`cycling_2005`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/cycling_2005.md)
  : Preprocessed cycling episodes (2005).
- [`cycling_2010`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/cycling_2010.md)
  : Preprocessed cycling episodes (2010).
- [`cycling_2015`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/cycling_2015.md)
  : Preprocessed cycling episodes (2015).
- [`cycling_2022`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/cycling_2022.md)
  : Preprocessed cycling episodes (2022).
- [`gss_episodes`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/gss_episodes.md)
  : Preprocessed walking and cycling episodes (from 1986 to 2022).
- [`gss_impedances`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/gss_impedances.md)
  : Impedance functions for Census Agglomerations and Census
  Metropolitan Areas (from 1986 to 2022).
- [`gss_main_1986`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/gss_main_1986.md)
  : Selection of socioeconomic variables from the 1986 GSS Time Use
  Survey (Cycle 2).
- [`gss_main_1992`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/gss_main_1992.md)
  : Selection of socioeconomic variables from the 1992 GSS Time Use
  Survey (Cycle 7).
- [`gss_main_1998`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/gss_main_1998.md)
  : Selection of socioeconomic variables from the 1998 GSS Time Use
  Survey (Cycle 12).
- [`gss_main_2005`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/gss_main_2005.md)
  : Selection of socioeconomic variables from the 2005 GSS Time Use
  Survey (Cycle 19).
- [`gss_main_2010`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/gss_main_2010.md)
  : Selection of socioeconomic variables from the 2010 GSS Time Use
  Survey (Cycle 29).
- [`gss_main_2015`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/gss_main_2015.md)
  : Selection of socioeconomic variables from the 2015 GSS Time Use
  Survey (Cycle 29).
- [`gss_main_2022`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/gss_main_2022.md)
  : Selection of socioeconomic variables from the 2022 GSS Time Use
  Survey.
- [`walking_1986`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/walking_1986.md)
  : Preprocessed walking episodes (1986).
- [`walking_1992`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/walking_1992.md)
  : Preprocessed walking episodes (1992).
- [`walking_1998`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/walking_1998.md)
  : Preprocessed walking episodes (1998).
- [`walking_2005`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/walking_2005.md)
  : Preprocessed walking episodes (2005).
- [`walking_2010`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/walking_2010.md)
  : Preprocessed walking episodes (2010).
- [`walking_2015`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/walking_2015.md)
  : Preprocessed walking episodes (2015).
- [`walking_2022`](https://dias-bruno.github.io/ActiveCA/reference/walking_2022.md)
  : Preprocessed walking episodes (2022).
